messages:
Ivy: If you could instantly master one non-work skill overnight, what would it be? No caveats.
Marco: Guitar. Always. Imagine being the person at parties. :guitar:
Rina: Fluent Japanese. Travel + anime comprehension = dream.
Omar: Knife skills and proper sourdough technique. Respect the crust.
Priya: Public speaking without sweating. Also podcast hosting voice.
Dylan: Carpentry. Build my own bookshelf that doesn't collapse.
Ivy: Also bonus question: would you use it for fun, side hustle, or humble flex?
Marco: Fun + flex. Maybe busk once.
Rina: Mostly fun, a little flex when ordering ramen in Tokyo.
Omar: Side hustle for sure. People pay for bread.
Priya: Flex -> career adjacent. Not work, but you know.
Dylan: Fun and side hustle depending on whether I can finish projects.
PollBot: Poll created: "One Skill to Master" 0 options: Guitar / Fluent Japanese / Cooking & knife skills / Public speaking / Carpentry
Ivy: Quick show of hands in thread replies if you picked a skill already listed.
Marco: +1 for guitar (me)
Rina: +1 Japanese
Omar: +1 sourdough
Priya: +1 public speaking
Dylan: +1 carpentry
PollBot: Current votes 0 Marco(Guitar), Rina(Fluent Japanese), Omar(Cooking & knife skills), Priya(Public speaking), Dylan(Carpentry)
Ivy: This actually tells me a lot about our team. Very artisanal.
Marco: We are the artisanal guild of Redwood.
Rina: If anyone wants language study buddies lmk.
Omar: Same, bread workshop IRL?
Priya: I'll take notes on your public speaking tips in exchange for homemade focaccia. Deal?
PollBot: Final tally: Guitar:1, Fluent Japanese:1, Cooking & knife skills:1, Public speaking:1, Carpentry:1
Ivy: Consensus = eclectic. Love it. Thanks for playing :)
